title: Pineapple Sorbet with Vanilla
changes_from_base: Fresh pineapple and a vanilla-pod syrup replace the mango; less lime juice.
summary: Ripe fresh pineapple blended with a vanilla-seed syrup and a little lime makes a sweet, fragrant sorbet.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Bring the sugar and water to the boil, take off the heat, scrape in the vanilla seeds, add the pod and cover. Leave until cool, then lift out the pod.

steps.title: Prepare the pineapple
steps.text: Cut off the top, base and skin, dig out the brown eyes, quarter it lengthways and cut away the woody core. Chop the flesh; you need about 800 g.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the pineapple with the vanilla syrup, lime juice and corn syrup until completely smooth, then sieve out any fibres.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and chill for at least 3 h.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min, then freeze for at least 2 h. Serve in scoops with a few fresh pineapple pieces.

tips: A ripe pineapple smells sweet at the base, and a leaf pulls out easily.
Rinse and dry the used vanilla pod and keep it in a jar of sugar to flavour it.
Serve with fresh mint leaves or a sprinkle of lime zest.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
